entries.en: barefoot, unshod
entries.notes: L 栏「Descabio」形近 descalzo（赤脚），H赤脚/M chia ca/R chī guīo 三栏一致，西语词头疑为刊刻讹形。

entries.zh: 宽解，宽舒；歇息放松（心安）
entries.en: relief, ease; to relax, to be at ease
entries.notes: L 栏「soa ch」与 M 栏「cūã ca…」均截断，释义取「寬」之宽解、宽舒义。

entries.en: rest; to rest
to lodge, to pass the night; lodging
rest; to rest from work, to be at leisure

entries.zh: 歇脚过夜，夜宿（行旅投宿）
entries.en: to lodge overnight on a journey; to put up for the night
to stop and rest; cessation
to rest; to sleep
to sleep; to pass the night sleeping

entries.zh: 闭嘴，不再开口（让嘴歇着）
entries.en: to rest one's mouth; to stop talking, to hold one's tongue
entries.notes: H「喙落檔」字形存疑、M/R 均损，释义以 L 栏「no hablar」（不说话）为据。

entries.en: to rest one's feet; to put up, to lodge
to spend the night; to lodge overnight
entries.notes: H 第二字 [疑:暝/具]，M(mê)/R(meng) 支持「暝」，即歇夜。

entries.en: to rest, to settle down to rest
to lean back and rest in a chair; to ease one's back for a moment
entries.notes: H「勒腰一下」与 M(tit yo chit e)、R(chy yan it hia) 难以密合，义从 L 栏「recostarse en la silla」（靠椅后仰）定。

entries.en: gratified, at ease; contentment, relief
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:慨/快]，从「快」读则与 L 栏 Descanso（宽解、舒坦）相合。

entries.en: to unload (a ship), to discharge cargo
to set down one's load; to unload a burden
to stay the night; to lodge
entries.notes: L 栏残缺；H 第二字「冷」与 M(chin)、R(king) 皆不合（[疑:冷/令] 难定），仅取「宿」之宿夜义。

entries.en: to lodge a grievance; to plead one's cause, to clear oneself
entries.notes: L 栏「descargar…」残缺，取 descargarse（自辩洗刷）之法律义；H 诉冤枉、M sou vàn ong、R 相合。

entries.en: to complain of; to bring a charge, to accuse
entries.notes: H 第二字 [疑:告/苦]，M(sou co) 合「告」，L 栏残缺而 descargar 亦有告讦、卸责之义。

entries.zh: 春风（字面义；此条与「歇息」的联系因原刊残缺不可解）
entries.en: spring breeze (literal; the link to 'rest' is lost with the damaged Spanish column)
entries.notes: L 栏「descansar, [残] con sus tentos」残缺，「tentos」难解，四栏无法互证，只存字面义。
